description.value:
Fixation & Possession

Doesn't crave broadly — fixates completely on one specific thing per follower (an object, a place, a cause) and will not loosen its grip, ever. Jealous of anything else that thing's attention goes to.

Areas of Concern fixation, possession, the one thing kept

Edicts never willingly release what you've claimed; guard it against all other attention

Anathema give up something you've marked as yours; share it freely

Religious Symbol a closed fist around a small object

Sacred Animal the jealous crow

Sacred Colors bruise-purple, tarnished gold
